messages:
Sam: Heads-up: NovaGen QBR prep. Onboarding is 80% complete but credit runway alarm tripped overnight. Need quick forecast, mitigation options, and an enablement checklist to avoid renewal friction. Elaine, can you run a 30d usage -> 30d forecast? Tess, any quick throttles we can suggest? Marta, can you prep a 45m optimization session draft? Michael, prepare a customer-friendly ask (cushion vs throttles). Jordan, hold promo-credit escalation.

Elaine: Running query now. Will produce 3 scenarios (continuation, mild reduction, aggressive optimization) and convert tokens->credits->USD. ETA 30m. Will output CSV and a small chart for the packet.

Onboard-Bot: System alert at 5612347890: account=novagen, credit_balance=1187, avg_daily_usage=920, projected_runway=~1.29 weeks.

Tess: Observed pattern: bursty embedding calls (many small vectors, high RPM) causing inefficient batching. Quick mitigation: limit embeddings RPM for 48-72h and deploy prefix-caching for repeated contexts. Proposed soft throttle:

```
embeddings_throttle:
  max_rpm: 50
  window: 72h
  rollback_if: errors_rate > 0.5% OR p99_latency > baseline * 1.5
  resume_if: 7d_avg_usage <= baseline * 0.8
  monitor: [credits/day, errors/5m, p95_latency]
```
Will add alert to auto-notify CS if throttle triggers.

Marta: I'll own the optimization session. Draft agenda: 5m intro, 10m usage anatomy + high-impact calls, 20m live embedding size & batching changes, 10m KV/prefix cache demo. Deliverable: 1-page ops playbook + post-session config PR template. Can do prep by EOD.

Michael: Draft customer ask: "Target a 90-day minimum runway. Options: A) One-time 20% credit top-up to reach 90-day runway, or B) Short-term throttle + 1-hr joint optimization with our team and a follow-up 30-day savings review. We recommend option B paired with a 2-week discretionary buffer if adoption is quick." Will turn into two slide visuals.

Sam: Elaine include a 20% reduction scenario and conservative throttle scenario. Please add exact dollar estimates for each option and a short note on expected feature impact (e.g., embedding latency vs throughput tradeoffs). Jordan, if forecast <14 days, escalate for emergency top-up.

Jordan: Noted. If forecast <14d, I'll submit a 1-month credit uplift request. If between 14-30d, I can approve a 2-week discretionary buffer. Keep me posted.

Elaine: Results: 30d history shows a sharp embedding ramp starting day -3. Projections:
- Continuation: runway ~10 days
- Mild reduction (-10%): runway ~11.5 days
- Aggressive (-25% + batching): runway ~16 days
Attached CSV & PNG (will add to QBR packet). Conversion: 1k tokens ~= 3 credits; 1 credit ~= $0.0045 USD (include table).

Sam: Good. Quick enablement checklist for before the QBR (deliverables for the customer): 1) Apply prefix cache snippet (we'll provide), 2) Reduce embed vector dims where possible, 3) Set temporary RPM throttle, 4) Join 45m optimization session, 5) Review post-session savings in 7 days. Marta to send PR template.

Marta: PR template + one-pager drafted. Sharing link in thread when finalized. Also prepared a demo snippet for prefix caching and a small sample config for batching.

Tess: I'll post the throttle rollout playbook and alerts config here in 15m. Also recommend enabling token-level cost reporting dashboard for the customer.

Sam: Recap & owners: Elaine (forecast + CSV/PNG) due in 30m, Michael (2 slides) EOD, Marta (session + PR template) EOD, Tess (throttle playbook) in 15m, Jordan (escalation) on-call. I'll assemble the QBR packet after Elaine posts. Thanks all :thumbsup:
